toast_micro.runner_source:
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qualification',Path(__file__).with_name('probe.py'));q=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(q)
q.RESULTS=root/'.qualification'/(q.RUN+'_toast_micro');q.RESULTS.mkdir();q.PROJECT+='-toast-micro';q.COMPOSE_FILE=q.RESULTS/'compose.yml';q.COMPOSE_FILE.write_text((root/'deploy/qualification/compose.yml').read_text())
def sql(text):return q.sql('destination','analytics',text)
report={'scope':'Exploratory append API storage-codec microbenchmark; not end-to-end qualification','runs':[]}
try:
 a=q.archive_path();q.verify_archive(a)
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:q.build_images(a,Path(d))
 q.compose('up','-d','--wait','--wait-timeout','300',timeout=600)
 sid=int(sql("SELECT lake_replication.create_subscription(42,1,1,'toast_bench','toast_bench',ARRAY['pub'])"))
 sql(f"CREATE TABLE public.toast_target(id bigint); INSERT INTO lake_replication.relations(subscription_id,remote_relation_id,schema_version,source_namespace,source_relation,replica_identity,columns) VALUES({sid},42,1,'public','toast_target','d','[]'); INSERT INTO lake_replication.initial_copies(subscription_id,remote_relation_id,relation_schema_version,destination_relation,consistent_lsn,snapshot_name,state,overwrite_destination) VALUES({sid},42,1,'public.toast_target','0/1','bench-snapshot','copying',false); CREATE TABLE public.toast_timings(seconds double precision)")
 for method in ['pglz','lz4','pglz']:
  sql(f"TRUNCATE lake_replication.initial_copy_chunks,public.toast_timings; UPDATE lake_replication.initial_copies SET rows_copied=0; SET default_toast_compression={method}; DO $bench$ DECLARE payload jsonb:=(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',n::text,'payload',repeat('b',128))) FROM generate_series(1,1000) n); began timestamptz; BEGIN began:=clock_timestamp(); FOR chunk IN 0..1999 LOOP PERFORM lake_replication.append_initial_copy_rows({sid},42,1,chunk::bigint*1000,payload); END LOOP; INSERT INTO public.toast_timings VALUES(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-began)); END $bench$")
  data=json.loads(sql("SELECT jsonb_build_object('seconds',(SELECT seconds FROM public.toast_timings),'chunks',count(*),'rows',sum(jsonb_array_length(rows)),'mean_stored_bytes',avg(pg_column_size(rows)),'compression',min(pg_column_compression(rows)),'relation_bytes',pg_total_relation_size('lake_replication.initial_copy_chunks')) FROM lake_replication.initial_copy_chunks"))
  assert data['compression']==method and data['rows']==2000000
  report['runs'].append(dict(method=method,**data));print(report['runs'][-1],flush=True)
 report['status']='completed'
except Exception as e:report.update(status='error',error=str(e));print('ERROR',e,flush=True)
finally:
 cleanup=q.compose('down','-v','--remove-orphans',check_result=False,timeout=300);report['cleanup_returncode']=cleanup.returncode;(q.RESULTS/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print('Evidence:',q.RESULTS,flush=True)
toast_micro.limitation: Exploratory API loop; raw report does not independently retain archive identity. End-to-end cohort verifies the exact archive separately.
